bookmark.status: Privacy-preserving notification system for help requests

IO3_transformations.operation: Send notifications to matched helpers. Record swipe-aways locally only. Never expose decline to requester.
IO3_transformations.algorithm: Staggered delivery: trusted first, verified second, general third

DW2_downstream_pipeline.description: Helper sees notification, can accept or swipe away

P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: Notification storms during mass events. Push service rate limits.
P.P2_defensibility: Staggered delivery reduces noise. Swipe-away privacy critical for adoption.
P4_failure_modes: Notification fatigue causes users to disable
P.P5_backup_plan: SMS fallback for critical requests. Frequency cap: max 5 help notifications per hour per user.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Simulate failure scenario in staging with mock data
P.P7_testing_strategy: Load test notification delivery at 10K concurrent requests. Test swipe-away privacy (verify no server-side recording of individual declines).
P.P8_benchmarks: Delivery <5s. Frequency cap enforced. Zero decline data leakage.

L.L1_legal_considerations: Swipe-away data NEVER stored server-side. Only local device analytics (aggregated).
L.L3_consent_requirements: Push notification consent via OS. SMS requires separate TCPA consent.

F.F1_cost_considerations: FCM + APNS: free tier covers most usage. SMS fallback: $0.01/msg.
F.F2_accounting_considerations: Allocated to help module operational budget

S.S1_cybersecurity: No PII in push payloads. Category + distance + brief description only.
S.S2_data_privacy: Individual decline decisions never transmitted to server. Requester sees only aggregate ('X notified, Y responded').
S.S3_encryption_requirements: TLS for push. No sensitive data in notification payload.
S.S5_audit_requirements: Audit trail on notification sends (not declines).

X.X2_open_questions: Confirm TCPA compliance for SMS fallback
